data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 were GBP 269.922m. During 2019 there was a very small favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 0.021m (a release), with net movements by line of business shown in the notes (favourable releases in Accident & health, Marine, Fire and Third party liability partially offset by adverse movements in Miscellaneous and Reinsurance). Overall the prior-year reserve movement was immaterial (less than GBP 0.1m).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, prior year column). Prior-year movement: gross aggregate 'Change in prior year provisions' is -GBP 21k (explicit in Technical Provisions note). The line-of-business breakdown available in the notes is presented net of reinsurance (the table in the claims note is 'Claims incurred, net of reinsurance' and the LOB movements are net amounts); gross LOB-level prior-year movements are not provided. Where only net LOB movements exist, those net values were used for lob_movements and flagged via confidence scores. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and used as a cross-check. No material RITC distortion noted for the annual accounts; the 2017 closed year RITC is disclosed separately in the closed-year accounts.
